blocks.title: Q3 Customer Support Performance Report
blocks.subtitle: A comprehensive review of our support metrics and improvements this quarter.
blocks.byline: Prepared by the Support Operations Team

blocks.title: Executive Summary
blocks.standfirst: A strong quarter of faster responses and a shrinking backlog.

paragraphs: This report details the performance of our customer support team during the third quarter, highlighting key improvements in response times and customer satisfaction.
Despite an increase in ticket volume, the team delivered faster responses and exceeded its satisfaction target.

blocks.label: Key Achievement
blocks.text: Median first response time improved from 3h 40m to 2h 14m while ticket volume grew 9%.

paragraphs: Billing questions remain the largest driver of support volume, followed by login issues and shipping delays.

blocks.quote: Great support is the backbone of customer loyalty.

blocks.title: Recommendations
blocks.standfirst: Three initiatives to reduce ticket volume in Q4.

items: Launch self-serve refunds to reduce billing-related tickets.
Roll out SSO to eliminate common login issues.
Send carrier tracking emails to proactively address shipping questions.

paragraphs: By implementing these recommendations, we expect to further reduce ticket volume and improve customer satisfaction in the coming quarter.

blocks.label: Next Steps
blocks.text: The support leadership team will present a detailed implementation plan for each initiative in early Q4.
